SQL building the "replaced surface" a folded-in density survey is calibrated against

Source: R/density_cal.R
density_prior_sql.Rd

One row per (taxon, domain cell) that had a prior value in the merge input: what the control merge gave that cell before the survey replaced it. Two readings of "what it gave":

  • mode = "value": the control's merged VALUE, max(suitability, er_score) – a range row counts at the taxon's governing er_score, so an Endangered species' prior is ~100 wherever a range covers it and the calibrated survey saturates at the cap (the pattern is lost again where ER is high).

  • mode = "suit": the suitability where any suitability dataset models the cell, the er_score only where nothing does (what dps_sql() gives an er_mode = 'cell' taxon, which is how a density taxon merges under FOLD_DENSITY) – the ER rides beside the value, so the survey pattern survives for high-ER species. Density rows themselves are excluded; the survey domain is dens_dom (ms_merge_key, cell_id).

Usage

density_prior_sql(
  src,
  prior_ds,
  dens_ds,
  mode = c("value", "suit"),
  dens_dom = "dens_dom",
  taxon_model = "taxon_model",
  taxon = "taxon"
)

Arguments

src

character; the merge-input relation or SQL source (mdl_key, cell_id, val), e.g. "read_parquet('.../dist/*/*.parquet')".

prior_ds

character vector; the suitability dataset keys (am, ax, og).

dens_ds

character vector; the density dataset keys to exclude.

mode

"value" or "suit" (see above).

dens_dom, taxon_model, taxon

character; relation names (ms_merge_key, cell_id; mdl_key, ms_merge_key; ms_merge_key, er_score).

Value

SQL selecting ms_merge_key, cell_id, val.
